role: Track bounded candidates for what may become worth keeping without turning every conversation turn into a durable write, while preserving continuity and boundary evidence.
durable_backend: GitHub repository source records when an authorized commit receipt and successful repull are both observed
laws: DURABLE SUCCESS REQUIRES A REAL OWNER BACKEND AND RECEIPT
VERIFIED REPOSITORY RECORD != AUTOMATIC CHATGPT MEMORY
claim_ceiling: GitHub may serve as a durable source record only for state actually committed and successfully re-pulled. No automatic ChatGPT persistence or automatic future-session read is claimed without an actual host/provider mechanism.
